description: adult man god of eternal ice, tall and regal, long white hair and a white beard, fair natural skin with a warm human face, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, frost glittering in the hair, a towering crown of jagged ice spikes, a long robe of deep blue velvet and white fur with armour plates of clear blue ice, frost mist close to the feet, holding a tall staff of clear blue ice topped with a large glowing snowflake crystal, the whole staff inside the image, cold and divine, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same man: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, godlike outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
